name: O*NET Web Services
tagline: U.S. occupation, skills, and career taxonomy from the Department of Labor
description: O*NET Web Services is the official REST API for the O*NET database, maintained by the U.S. Department of Labor. It provides structured data on occupations, skills, abilities, knowledge, work activities, tools/technology, career pathways, and related career exploration content used by job boards, workforce tools, and labor-market applications. Access requires free registration; responses are typically XML or JSON.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth with registered username and password (or API key credentials from free developer signup). Credentials are issued after account registration at services.onetcenter.org.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free registration; usage limits not clearly published as a numeric free tier on the public site

example.response_snippet: {"code":"17-2051.00","title":"Civil Engineers","tags":{"bright_outlook":true,"green":false},"description":"Perform engineering duties in planning, designing, and overseeing construction and maintenance of building structures and facilities..."}

use_cases: look up occupation details by O*NET-SOC code
search occupations by keyword or title
get skills, abilities, and knowledge required for a job
list related occupations and career pathways
retrieve tools and technology used in an occupation
